vnext_question: Where is repeatability retained, redirected or lost as a recurrent pollination problem propagates toward realized floral evolution?
vnext_claim: A recurrent pollination problem can yield recurrent functional responses without a recurrent detailed floral phenotype because repeatability can persist in the coarse mean response while being redirected or lost by state-dependent selection, reproductive context, genetic accessibility and finite-population realization.
promotion_requirements: explicit decision to reopen the current submission package
regenerate main figures around the syndrome-as-outcome causal architecture
update Supporting Information with Stage A-D designs and the retained negative Stage C result
update active manuscript and canonical story together
update submission manifest and scientific lock together
run the full fail-closed submission and reviewer-archive gates
prohibited_until_promotion: do not present the vNext manuscript as the active Oikos submission
do not claim literal flower-colour or corolla-geometry calibration
do not claim a universal colour-easy morphology-hard genetic hierarchy
do not erase or retune the failed prospective mutation-pleiotropy result
do not present assurance-by-cost adaptive reduction as a robust headline mechanism
do not retain the earlier 9.4% standing-variation versus mutation effect-size ratio as general
do not claim equilibrium standing-variation dominance over mutation
do not quantitatively fit source-audited island systems to synthetic Model 3 cells
do not describe the natural deterministic bridge as uniformly negative across all 128 histories without an inbreeding-depression qualification
do not claim quantitative reproduction of the Chapter 1 H1-H4 coefficient vector
do not reopen Model3R/Model3E parameter or mechanism search as a Chapter 2 completion gate

mutation_pleiotropy_timing.reason: investment sustained-crossing endpoint was largely censored at the preregistered 0.05 threshold over 400 years

route_A_robustness.reason: negative region was non-isolated but central sign boundary shifted with inbreeding depression and inherited response failed the all-life-history criterion

deterministic_backbone_uniformity.reason: mean and all starting-state effects remain negative at depression 0.75, but 11/128 histories are mixed across starts and 1/128 is positive-only

novelty_boundary.not_novel: syndrome labels are descriptive/outcome concepts rather than unique mechanisms
novelty_boundary.novel_target: preregistered single-model interventions that treat syndrome evolution as transmission of repeatability and locate where a common perturbation retains, redirects, attenuates or loses repeatability across ecological selection, reproductive context, genetic accessibility and finite realization

empirical_emulation_boundary.interpretation: Model 3 remains a mechanistic reconstruction of a Chapter-1-compatible syndrome structure, not a quantitative fit to the Chapter 1 regional coefficient vector.
empirical_emulation_boundary.future_flora_level_model: separate study requiring disclosure of the four failed model families and prospective model-family/validation lock
